name: claude-council
description: Consult multiple AI coding agents (Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, any model OpenRouter routes to, plus codex, antigravity, grok, kimi and cursor CLIs when installed, and a local ollama model) to get diverse perspectives on coding problems, with a streaming pane in tmux or inside Claude Code

pane_host.title: Pane opens in
pane_host.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. claude-code draws the pane inside Claude Code; tmux leaves it to the tmux pane; ask puts the question once inside tmux and remembers the answer.

collapse_when_done.title: Collapse status when done
collapse_when_done.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Replace the provider list with a one-line summary once a run finishes.

wake_on_async_done.title: Wake on async finish
wake_on_async_done.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Submit a prompt when a background council run completes. Starts a model turn, which costs tokens.

council_tool.title: Council as a tool
council_tool.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Let the model call the council as a tool. Off by default: the council sends your question to third-party providers, and a tool is easier to call unprompted than a slash command.
